data.narrative:
Vermeer operates in Defense & Security at the Series A stage. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer universe of 10 private companies and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), with primary reliance on three same-sector, same-stage private peers: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage step-ups, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the three identified comparables yields a $400M valuation, though the peer sample exhibits significant dispersion (range: $125M–$4.0B). This wide range reflects heterogeneity within the Defense & Security frontier-tech space at Series A.

Triangulation across these two methods supports a valuation range of $17M–$460M, with a median implied value of $210M. The low end approximates stage-progression methodology, while the high end converges toward peer-median valuation. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer set, the relevance of the $4.0B Stark Defence comparable (a significant outlier), and whether $10M in total raised adequately represents Vermeer's asset base relative to more mature comparables. Resolution of product-market fit evidence and customer traction would narrow this range materially.
